title: Anchoring Event
description: A deterministic record of a hash-anchoring event on an external blockchain. Produced after a successful notarizeHash transaction or a verified historical anchor. This is off-chain evidence — CORE validates structure and consistency, not on-chain state.

submission_ref.description: Reference to the anchoring_submission that produced this event

anchor_hash.description: The bytes32 hash that was anchored on-chain

artifact_fingerprint.description: The CORE canonical fingerprint of the anchored artefact (must match anchor_hash when converted)

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID where the anchor was recorded

anchorer.description: Address that submitted the notarizeHash transaction (checksummed)

block_number.description: Block number where the HashAnchored event was emitted

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash of the notarizeHash call

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the block (or submission if block timestamp unavailable)

event_fingerprint.description: Canonical fingerprint of this event document (excluding the event_fingerprint field itself)

artifact_type.description: Type of the artefact that was anchored

core_version.description: CORE version that produced this event

log_index.description: Log index within the block for the HashAnchored event

metadata.description: Optional metadata about the anchoring event
